out.title: RBI approves re-appointment of V. Srinivasa Rangan as Executive Director
out.summary: RBI approved re-appointment of V. Srinivasa Rangan as Whole-time Director (Executive Director) of HDFC Bank for one year from November 23, 2026, at extant remuneration.

person.name: V. Srinivasa Rangan
person.bio: Existing Executive Director of HDFC Bank (DIN 00030248); not related to any other director or KMP and not debarred by SEBI or any authority.
